title: feat(types,fields)!: the grid field's columns and object-chart's dataSource are the spec's, by reference; GridColumnDefinition retires (objectui#11070, round 7)
body:
Refs #11070
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). The strict face's accept set widens (a grid field's `columns` and an `object-chart` node's `dataSource` binding parse), and the tolerant face narrows (both keys are now judged by their declared type: a grid column the spec refuses, or a non-binding `dataSource` on `object-chart`, is refused where it used to be stripped or kept unjudged). `GridColumnDefinition` retires from `@object-ui/types`, and `GridColumn` in `@object-ui/fields` becomes the spec's `InlineGridColumn`. Priced in `.changeset/11070-grid-columns-chart-binding-round7.md` as minor with a BREAKING banner.

`Refs`, not a closing keyword, on purpose. Round 7 of the card, under the seat's claim `5925545318` (remainder items 2 and 3 of `5919314708`). Draft; the dev does not mark it ready.

## What changed

**(i) The grid field's `columns`, by reference to the spec.**
- `GridFieldMetadata.columns` (`field-types.ts`) and `FormField.columns` (`form.ts`) are `SpecField['inlineColumns']`; the zod mirror `FormFieldSchema` declares `stripImportedDefaults(SpecFieldSchema).shape.inlineColumns`. `form-field-zod-coverage` gains the `columns` row. `FormFieldSchema` was already a registered, spec-derived pair in `zod-mirror-parity`; its `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS` note records the new member, and no ledger total moved.
- `GridColumnDefinition` is retired (interface and barrel export). Nothing in production read it, and it was not the shape the widget read.
- `GridField`'s `GridColumn` is `InlineGridColumn` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, by reference. The renderer notes its per-member JSDoc carried move into one docblock. No read changes: the widget already read exactly the spec's twenty keys.
- Fixtures: `fields-grid/*` already write only `name` / `label` / `type`; all nine columns parse against the spec element, so none changes.
- `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`: the typed fence drops a column `defaultValue`; the prose names the spec column and lists the nine cell types; the plaintext fences stop teaching `boolean`, `percent` and `user` column types; the validation sketch drops a column `min` the column does not have.

**(ii) `object-chart` · `dataSource`, re-measured and declared.**
- `ObjectChartSchema` (TypeScript and the flat zod mirror) declares `dataSource` as the spec's `ElementDataSource` / `ElementDataSourceSchema`, by reference. `OBJECT_CHART_NODE_LEVEL_KEYS` keeps it out of the authored bag, and `ObjectChartBlockSchema` carries it at node level (the mirror's own member), as `ObjectFormBlockSchema` and `ObjectMapBlockSchema` do.
- The stale `SHOWCASE_NODE` pin (`object-chart-react-tier-node-10770.test.ts`) drops `dataSource: null` and the comment describing a wrapper write that round 2 removed; a binding row and a `null`-refused row join it.

**Rows the declarations force (fixture triage):** `object-chart-properties-bag-11276` (the node-level key set gains `dataSource`, on the type and runtime legs; its "left undeclared" row becomes a "parses at node level, not a bag member" row) and `public-block-responsive-styles-10872` (`DECLARES_DATA_SOURCE` names `object-chart`, the control built to redden exactly when an arm gains the key). `strict-face-read-keys-11070` moves `columns` and `object-chart` to the declared blocks and empties its PENDING list. Comment-only: `deriveMasterDetail.declaredSpelling.test.tsx`, and the two `GridField` tests now type their fixtures `GridFieldMetadata['columns']`.

**Changesets.** One new (`@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields` minor). Dated notes on the five pending changesets of this release whose sentence the round makes false: `11276-object-chart-properties-bag`, `10872-flat-arm-responsive-styles`, `11070-strict-face-read-keys`, `6138-fields-schema-block-parity-pr2`, `8209-datetime-widget-faces`.

## Census (i): the grid column, measured at `5262f7dd`

| source | shape |
|:--|:--|
| installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 | No `grid` field type and no `columns` member on `FieldSchema`. The list is `inlineColumns` (on `master_detail`), elements `InlineGridColumnSchema`: strict, 20 keys (`name` required; `label`, `type` in nine values, `width`, `required`, `options`, `prefix`, `step`, `reference`, `displayField`, `idField`, `multiple`, `accept`, `defaultHidden`, `computed`, `expr`, `scale`, `autofill`, `readonlyWhen`, `requiredWhen`). Named refusals: `field` / `fieldName` / `key` (→ `name`), `title` / `header` (→ `label`), `size`, `expression`, `hidden`; `scale` refused on a `currency` column. |
| `GridField`'s local `GridColumn` | The same 20 keys and the same nine-value `type`. Value domain differs on `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` only (local object arm had an optional free-string `dialect`). |
| what `GridField` reads | `cfg.columns`, and per column exactly those 20 keys (a census of member reads off the column: 20 distinct, 0 outside the spec; no spread or computed read of a column). |
| `GridColumnDefinition` | 7 keys: `name`, `label`, `type` (required, free string), `required`, `defaultValue`, `width`, `validate`. 2 keys not in the spec, `type` wider. Production readers: 0 (two `fields` tests and the docs prose). |
| `fields-grid/*` fixtures | 3 documents, 9 columns, keys `name` / `label` / `type` (`text`, `number`, `currency`, `date`); 9 of 9 parse against `InlineGridColumnSchema`. |
| `grid.mdx` | typed fence: a column `defaultValue`; plaintext fences: `boolean` (2), `percent`, `user` column types; validation sketch: a column `min`. |
| objectstack example apps (`94608a7d7`) | No `grid` field (the spec has none). One producer of the spec element: `app-showcase` `invoice.object.ts` `inlineColumns`, seven identity-only `{ name }` entries. |

H1 holds in substance, not as posed: the spec declares no grid `columns`; its `inlineColumns` element is key-for-key `GridColumn`. H2 holds: `GridColumnDefinition` had no production reader, so it retires. No non-spec column spelling is read, so nothing else retires and no producer stop applied. The alignment is a type reference, not a renderer redesign.

## Census (ii): `object-chart` · `dataSource` on `5262f7dd`

| fact | reading |
|:--|:--|
| renderer read | the `object-chart` registration is `elementDataSourceBlock`-wrapped; `ElementDataSourceGate` reads the node's `dataSource` and lands `object` on `objectName` |
| producer | the react-page wrapper builds `{ ...props, specType, type }`, no `dataSource` write (round 2) |
| strict face | `{ type: 'object-chart', properties: { objectName, chartType }, dataSource: { object } }` refused, unrecognized key `dataSource` |
| tolerant face | the same document, and `dataSource: null` or an adapter object, accepted unjudged (the arm is passthrough) |

Not resolved by PR #11328 or round 2, and no ruling needed: declared like the seven other gate-wrapped blocks.

## M3 before / after

`scripts/measure-strict-authoring-face.mjs --json` plus the PR #11069 `findUndeclaredKeys` port for pairs, each on a freshly built `@object-ui/types`.

| reading | base `5262f7dd` | main `770cc5ba` | this head `62fe84ae` |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| documents | 601 | 601 | 601 |
| nodes | 2229 | 2229 | 2229 |

Main to head: exactly `form · fields[].columns` (3 occurrences, 3 strict-only, the three `fields-grid` documents) leaves; no pair enters or moves, and the tolerant face refuses the same documents. H3 holds. `object-chart` · `dataSource` has no corpus occurrence, so it moves no M3 figure; its pins carry it.

## Verification

All on this branch; heavy runs through `os-verify-lock` with 2 workers and a memory watchdog.

- `@object-ui/types`: `type-check` exit 0 and `vitest packages/types/` 309 files / 7828 tests passed at `62fe84ae`; build exit 0.
- `type-check` exit 0 in all 11 census packages (types, core, components, fields, plugin-form, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-detail, plugin-tree, plugin-grid, schema-catalog) at `3eecfc2c`.
- Tests at `3eecfc2c`: `packages/fields/` 226 files passed, 1 skipped (3515 tests); `packages/plugin-form/` 157 / 1822; `packages/plugin-charts/` + `examples/schema-catalog/` 121 / 3233; the 86 test files outside those packages that read the zod faces, 86 / 2110.
- Reverse type check: a temporary `plugin-form` file assigning a `boolean` column, a column `defaultValue`, an adapter `dataSource` and a dialect-less `readonlyWhen` object made `tsc` exit 2 with exactly those four errors (TS2322, TS2353, TS2353, TS2322), and a spec-valid control line none; the file was removed.
- Ablations, committed first, predicted in writing before each run, through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restore blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; subjects resolve from source):
  - A1, item (i): drop `FormFieldSchema.columns`. Predicted 7 red + tsc red; measured 7 failed / 52 passed, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2 (the parity ledger).
  - A1b, docs leg: plant the column `defaultValue` back in `grid.mdx`'s typed fence. Predicted 1 block red; measured `check:doc-snippets` 698 judged, 1 failed (TS2353 on `defaultValue`).
  - A2, item (ii): drop `dataSource` from `ObjectChartBlockSchema`. Predicted 5 red, tsc green; measured 5 failed / 321 passed, tsc exit 0.
- Gates at `62fe84ae`: `check:doc-snippets` 698 of 698 judged, 0 failed (closure rebuilt, 35 of 35 tasks); `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-example-ids` all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 23 net paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Narrowed lint: the population is `**/*.{ts,tsx}` (the config's `files`), so 16 of the 23 changed paths; `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on those 16 at head and at the base: 0 new errors, warnings equal per file except `field-types.ts` 5 → 4. The one error (`index.ts`, `no-restricted-imports`) is present at the base too. The config has no type-aware linting and no rule reads another file, so the diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.

## Notes

- **The `Spec Main Shape Gate`.** objectui#11330's repair (PR #11343) landed on `main` as `47e3ce00` and is merged into this branch, so its fleet-wide red is not expected here; the result is CI's.
- **PR #11333** (round 6) shares `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` on disjoint hunks (`FormulaFieldMetadata` there, the grid metadata here). This branch merges `main` again once it lands.
- **Not touched:** `strict-authoring-face.ts`, PR #11333's surface, `docs/adr/0001-master-detail-subform.md` (a governed record that still names `GridColumnDefinition`).

## Acceptance notes

- `grid.mdx`'s typed fence still teaches `allow_reorder: false`. `GridFieldMetadata` declares `allow_reorder`, and `GridField` reads `reorderable`: a probe rendering the widget measured two drag handles with no key, two with `allow_reorder: false`, and none with `reorderable: false`. The widget's other field-level reads (`total_field`, `amount_field`, `amountField`, `allow_duplicate`, `show_line_numbers`, `sort_field`, `add_label`, `reorderable`) are declared on neither face. These are field-level keys, outside this round's `columns` scope; they are in the report for the seat.
